mechanism_narrative: A persistent low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is observed (regardless of level), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates a weakening consumer demand environment, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 110, indicating a supply-driven expansion, the S&P 500 experiences positive 60-day forward returns due to robust industrial activity supporting corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it reflects a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is observed (regardless of level), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 (thousands) indicates a weakening housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1500.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL increasing) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 2.0%) creates stagflationary risks, which depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is rising and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic growth regime (GDPC1 > 19000), the S&P 500 experiences positive 60-day forward returns due to robust corporate earnings and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 19000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
